chunks: On which all affairs are sorted out and decided

key_terms.فِيهَا: On it (referring to the Night of Decree)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'all affairs are sorted out' on the Night of Decree?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to Laylat al-Qadr, the night when the 'Preserved Tablet' (Al-Lawh Al-Mahfuz) is opened to decree the affairs of the coming year. This event underscores the divine wisdom (Hakim) governing the universe, linking cosmic destiny with the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt who are seen as the executors of these divine commands.
